facts.summary: Interim analysis recommended halting for futility · Phase 3 · HyBryte in cutaneous T-cell lymphoma · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Under the terms of the interim analysis, the study was recommended to halt for futility.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: the second HyBryte™ (SGX301) Phase 3 clinical trial did not demonstrate sufficient efficacy at the interim analysis to support continuation of the study
evidence.safety: has demonstrated a good safety profile in the pre-specific safety evaluations by the Data Monitoring Committee
evidence.program_discontinued: In light of the discontinuation of the FLASH2 study, the Company’s ability to continue as a going concern will be dependent upon its ability to develop and commercialize its remaining pipeline assets
